paragraphs.text: Local GPT-SoVITS TTS for DeepSeek Harness: reads assistant replies aloud with a draggable mascot and
one-click installer.
# dsh-dania-voice
**English** | 简体中文

Local **GPT-SoVITS** text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness. It reads assistant replies aloud in a
fine
-tuned voice, controlled by a small draggable mascot hanging at the top of the interface.
Everything runs on your machine — no audio, no text leaves it.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Playback happens in the browser on purpose: the Host process has no audio device, and the voice
shou
ld come out of **the machine you are actually sitting at**.

When cleaning, inline code is not dropped — `ops_bash` is spoken as `ops bash`, and long
all-caps wo

rds are lowercased so the model reads them as words instead of spelling out
`E X E C U T O R`. Code

blocks become a single spoken cue ("there's a code block here")
instead of being read line by line.
## Requirements
| Item | Note |

| DSH | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |
| Python | **3.10 – 3.12** (the installer looks for it; it does not instal

l Python) |
| GPU | NVIDIA with 8 GB+ VRAM recommended. CPU works but is several times slower. |
| D
isk | ~5 GB (PyTorch + base models + voice model) |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then open the mascot panel and click **One-click setup**. The installer runs as a separate
process a
nd reports progress into the same panel:

1. creates a Python venv under the install directory
2. installs PyTorch (CUDA build when `nvidia-sm

i` is present)
3. installs the inference dependencies
4. downloads GPT-SoVITS source (~50 MB)
5. dow

nloads the pretrained base models (~1.6 GB)
6. downloads the voice model and its reference audio (~3

the pretrained base models (~1.6 GB)
6. downloads the voice model and its reference audio (~320 MB)

It is idempotent — if it fails halfway, click again and completed steps are skipped. That matters
be
cause step 5 is a 1.6 GB download.

The default install directory is `$DSH_HOME/dania-voice`. Override it with `installDir` if you
want
it on another drive.
## Usage
A mascot hangs at the top centre of the window:

- **Click** — toggle reading on/off
- **Drag** — move it anywhere; the position is remembered
- **Ri

ght-click / Shift+click** — open the settings panel
- While reading, the mascot gently bobs

Panel controls: volume, speed, temperature (lower = steadier, less breathiness), inter-sentence
paus
e, plus **repeat last reply** and **say a line** for testing.

Changing speed/temperature applies to the next synthesis; audio is cached by `text + parameters`,
so
repeating with the same settings is instant.
## Configuration

Written to `$DSH_HOME/dania-voice/config.json` by the panel. The `config:` block in your profile
pat
ch works too and is overridden by the panel.
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `volume` / `speed` / `temperature` | `1` / `1` / `0.7` | Pl

ayback and sampling |
| `speakUser` | `false` | Also read your own messages |
| `installDir` | `$DSH

_HOME/dania-voice` | Where the engine lives |
| `pythonPath` / `root` / `cacheDir` | derived | Only

needed for a hand-made install |
| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:9880` | GPT-SoVITS endpoint |
| `au
tostart` | `true` | Start the service when needed |
## Known limitations

**Short English tokens sound mushy.** A full English sentence comes out fine — transcribing a
synthe

sised sentence back gives an almost exact match. But short identifiers or ones with digits
(`ops bas

h`, `cut2`, `sha1`) come out close to Chinese syllables, as if the voice were mumbling.
That is a mi

smatch between the voice model and English phonemes, not something the plugin can
fix. Inline code i
s still turned into speakable English; longer identifiers fare better than short ones.

**A segment is capped at 90 characters.** The server's generation loop is hard-coded to 1500
semanti

c tokens (~30 s); past that it stops silently and truncates. With 147 characters in one
unsegmented

request, a whole sentence went missing in testing. 90 leaves about 30% headroom, at
the cost of more
pauses between segments.

**URLs and tables are not spoken.** A URL reads as a string of letters nobody can follow, and a
tabl

e reads as a list of numbers; both are dropped. The dropped spot is closed with a full stop so
the n
eighbouring sentences are not glued together.
## Troubleshooting
- **Mascot shows a red border** — the plugin's routes are not answering; check that the plugin is en

abled.
- **"Not installed yet"** — click one-click setup, or check `$DSH_HOME/dania-voice/install.lo

g`.
- **No sound but the panel says ready** — the browser blocked autoplay; click the mascot once.
-
**Slow first line** — the model takes 20–40 s to load into VRAM; later lines take 1–3 s.
